name: Remove WP Admin Bar
author: Dhrumil Kumbhani

sections.description:
Remove WP Admin Bar is a lightweight and powerful WordPress plugin that allows you to control the visibility of the WordPress admin bar based on user roles.

The WordPress admin bar (toolbar) appears on the front end for logged-in users. While it is useful for administrators and editors, it can be distracting, unnecessary, or confusing for subscribers, customers, contributors, or clients.

This plugin gives you full control over who can see the admin bar — without writing a single line of code.

Perfect for membership sites, WooCommerce stores, client websites, LMS platforms, multi-author blogs, and agency-managed WordPress installations.

Why Remove the WordPress Admin Bar?

The admin bar may:

• Distract front-end users
• Break design consistency
• Interfere with custom themes
• Confuse customers or subscribers
• Impact user experience on membership sites

With Remove WP Admin Bar, you can create a clean, professional, and distraction-free front-end experience.

Key Features

Role-Based Admin Bar Control

Choose exactly which user roles can see the admin bar and which cannot. Supports all default WordPress roles and custom user roles.

Clean Front-End Experience

Hide the admin bar for non-admin users to maintain a polished website design.

One-Click Configuration

Simple settings page. No coding required. Enable or disable admin bar visibility in seconds.

Works with Custom User Roles

Compatible with membership plugins and custom role management plugins.

SEO & Performance Friendly

Removing unnecessary UI elements improves user experience and may contribute to better engagement metrics.

Lightweight & Optimized

Minimal code, no performance overhead, fully optimized for speed.

Use Cases

• Hide admin bar for WooCommerce customers
• Remove admin bar for subscribers
• Disable admin bar on membership sites
• Clean up UI for client websites
• Improve user experience for logged-in users
• Create distraction-free front-end environments

Compatible With

• Latest WordPress versions
• Gutenberg Block Editor
• Classic Editor
• WooCommerce
• Membership plugins
• LMS plugins
• Most modern WordPress themes

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Settings → Remove WP Admin Bar.
  3. Select the user roles for which you want to hide the admin bar.
  4. Save changes.
  5. Done!

The admin bar will now be hidden based on your selected roles.

Benefits of Using Remove WP Admin Bar

• Better user experience
• Cleaner website appearance
• Improved professionalism
• Role-based flexibility
• Easy configuration
• No coding required

If you’re looking for a simple and reliable way to remove the WordPress admin bar for specific users, this plugin is the perfect solution.

Install Remove WP Admin Bar today and create a cleaner, more focused WordPress experience.
sections.installation:
Follow the below instructions to install this plugin to your WordPress website.

Ex.

  1. Upload to the wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the \’Plugins\’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the settings section and open Remove WP Admin Bar.
  4. Select the user and save it.
  5. Enjoy!
